# MkDocs

Covers MkDocs, Material for MkDocs, Zensical and ProperDocs.

## Detect

- `mkdocs.yml` / `mkdocs.yaml`: MkDocs. `theme.name: material` means Material for MkDocs.
- `zensical.toml`: Zensical (MkDocs keys in TOML under `[project]`). `properdocs.yml`: ProperDocs. Both also read `mkdocs.yml`.
- Python dependencies (`mkdocs`, `mkdocs-material`, `zensical`, `properdocs`) or `mkdocs build` in CI confirm it.
- The config file wins. If there are several, migrate the one CI builds and report the others.
- Resolve `INHERIT:` (deep-merges a parent config) and `!ENV [VAR, default]` (use the default, report the variable) before mapping. Read `!!python/...` tags as text.

## Get the source

### From the repo

- Pages are the `.md` files under `docs_dir` (default `docs/`), minus `exclude_docs`.
- Build: `mkdocs build -d <dir>` or `zensical build` (`mint migrate --topic discovery`, From the repo).

### From an export

None; the site is built from the repo.

### From the live site

Page sources through `repo_url` + `edit_uri`.

## Config → docs.json

| mkdocs.yml                                                                                                           | docs.json                                                                                      |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `site_name` / `site_description`                                                                                     | `name` / `description`                                                                         |
| `repo_url`                                                                                                           | `navbar.links` (`type: github` for GitHub)                                                     |
| `theme.logo` / `theme.favicon`                                                                                       | `logo` / `favicon`                                                                             |
| `theme.palette.primary`                                                                                              | `colors.primary`, from the rendered link color's hex (Material color names are not CSS colors) |
| `theme.palette` with only `scheme: slate`                                                                            | `appearance.default: "dark"`                                                                   |
| `theme.font.text`                                                                                                    | `fonts.family`                                                                                 |
| `extra.social`                                                                                                       | `footer.socials`                                                                               |
| `extra.analytics` (`provider: google`)                                                                               | `integrations.ga4.measurementId`                                                               |
| `extra.*` read by the macros plugin                                                                                  | `variables` (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Template tags)                                 |
| `extra_css` / `extra_javascript`                                                                                     | (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Chrome)                                                    |
| `nav`                                                                                                                | Navigation below                                                                               |
| `site_url`                                                                                                           | none; its host and path prefix are part of every old URL                                       |
| `copyright`, `edit_uri`, `theme.features`, `markdown_extensions`, `hooks`, `theme.custom_dir`, build and server keys | drop and report                                                                                |

Plugins: `redirects` → URLs below; `git-revision-date*` → `metadata.timestamp`; `awesome-pages`, `awesome-nav`, `literate-nav` → Navigation; `search`, `social`, `minify`, `privacy`, `offline` → drop; `macros`, `mkdocstrings`, `gen-files`, `mkdocs-jupyter`, `blog`, `i18n`, `mike` → Known gaps.

Reference: https://www.mkdocs.org/user-guide/configuration/

## Navigation

- `nav` entries: `- Label: page.md`, `- page.md` (label from the page), `- Label: https://...` (external), `- Section: [ ... ]` (nested).
- Material `theme.features: navigation.tabs`: each top-level section is a tab. Without it, top-level sections are groups.
- Material `navigation.indexes`: a section's leading `index.md` is the section's own page → group `root`.
- External `nav` entries → `navigation.global.anchors`, or a tab `href` if they sat in the tab row.
- No `nav`: MkDocs lists each folder's files alphabetically, `index` first, subfolders after files.
- `.pages` (awesome-pages) and `.nav.yml` (awesome-nav) set per-folder title and order. A literate-nav `SUMMARY.md` is a nested link list read like `nav`; it is not a page.
- `not_in_nav` pages are hidden pages.

Reference: https://squidfunk.github.io/mkdocs-material/setup/setting-up-navigation/

## Content conversion

| MkDocs / Material / pymdownx                                                                               | Mintlify                                                                                                              |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `!!! type "Title"` (body indented 4)                                                                       | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Admonitions)                                                                      |
| `??? type "Title"` / `???+`                                                                                | `<Accordion>` / `<Accordion defaultOpen>`                                                                             |
| `=== "Label"` runs (`===+` selects a tab, `===!` starts a new set)                                         | `<Tabs>` / `<Tab>`; `<CodeGroup>` when every tab is one code block                                                    |
| `/// admonition`, `/// details`, `/// tab` blocks                                                          | same targets as `!!!`, `???`, `===`                                                                                   |
| fence `title="x"`, `hl_lines="2 4-5"`, `linenums="1"`                                                      | fence title, `highlight={2,4-5}`, `lines`                                                                             |
| inline `` `#!python code` ``                                                                               | plain inline code                                                                                                     |
| code annotations (`# (1)!` + a numbered list)                                                              | the list as prose below the block; report                                                                             |
| `--8<--` snippets (paths resolve from `base_path`, not the page; `file:3:10` ranges, `file:name` sections) | code: (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Code imports); prose: (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Reusable content) |
| include-markdown `{% include "x.md" %}`                                                                    | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Reusable content)                                                                 |
| `{ #id }` on a heading                                                                                     | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Heading IDs)                                                                      |
| other attribute lists (`{ .md-button }`, `{ width=... }`)                                                  | delete; buttons become links or `<Card>`                                                                              |
| `<div class="grid cards" markdown>`                                                                        | `<Columns>` of `<Card>`                                                                                               |
| `++ctrl+c++`, `==x==`, `^^x^^`                                                                             | `<kbd>`, `<mark>`, `<ins>`                                                                                            |
| `:material-x:`, `:octicons-x:`, `:fontawesome-x:`                                                          | `<Icon>`, or delete                                                                                                   |
| arithmatex `\( \)`, `\[ \]`                                                                                | `$ $`, `$$ $$`                                                                                                        |
| abbreviations `*[TERM]: ...`, `[TOC]`                                                                      | delete                                                                                                                |
| `![](x.png#only-light)` / `#only-dark`                                                                     | light/dark image pair                                                                                                 |
| macros `{{ }}` / `{% %}`                                                                                   | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Template tags)                                                                    |
| `hide: [toc]` / `hide: [navigation]` / `hide: [footer]`                                                    | `mode: "wide"` / `mode: "center"` / `hideFooterPagination`                                                            |
| `status: deprecated` / `status: new`                                                                       | `deprecated` / `tag`                                                                                                  |
| `tags`, `search.exclude`                                                                                   | `keywords`, `searchable: false`                                                                                       |

Folder `.meta.yml` files (meta plugin) set frontmatter for every page in the folder.

References: https://squidfunk.github.io/mkdocs-material/reference/ and https://facelessuser.github.io/pymdown-extensions/

## Assets

- Referenced non-Markdown files under `docs_dir` keep their paths.
- Files at the `docs_dir` root served by URL (`CNAME`, verification files): report.

## URLs and redirects

- `use_directory_urls: true` (default): `a/b.md` → `/a/b/`, `a/index.md` → `/a/`.
- `use_directory_urls: false`: `a/b.md` → `/a/b.html` (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Redirects).
- `README.md` serves its folder when there is no `index.md` (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Files).
- `redirects` plugin `redirect_maps` (`old.md: new.md`): one redirect per entry, both sides as URLs.
- mike serves versions at `/<version>/` and aliases such as `/latest/`. Redirect `/<alias>/:slug*` to the migrated version.

## Known gaps

- mkdocstrings, mkdocs-click, gen-files and Jupyter output.
- macros logic (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Template tags).
- Blog plugin, tag index pages, RSS.
- i18n plugins; mike versions other than the migrated one.
- Code annotations, admonition colors, inline admonitions, cross-page linked tabs.
- `hooks`, `theme.custom_dir` overrides, plugins without a mapping.
- Heading anchors (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Heading IDs).
